overview.description: The iShares Bitcoin Premium Income ETF (BITA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long btc, short usd currency. The fund seeks to provide bitcoin exposure and premium income through a covered call strategy. The fund holds bitcoin and IBIT shares while writing call options primarily on IBIT to generate option premium income. BITA was launched on Jun 9, 2026 and is issued by BlackRock.
